rulesClauses: You may banish any amount of cards with floating memory from your graveyard. For each card banished this way, put a refinement counter on Arondight.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. ArondightBanishChoice was queued without dontSkipOnPass, so declining a further banish (MZMAYCHOOSE answered PASS) made ExecuteStaticMethods() skip the handler and its done branch (AddCounters refinement = banished count) never ran: a floating-memory card was banished and Arondight got no refinement counter (live repro on HEAD: Counters empty). Fix: dontSkipOnPass:1 at the queue site.
